job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS 2017 RFP for real estate investment consultant services?
job.acceptance: March 20, 2017, 4:30 p.m. HST or explicit equivalent timezone conversion.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2016 South Carolina RFP for general investment consulting services, not the Hawaii ERS 2017 RFP for real estate investment consultant services. Its proposal deadline pertains to the different solicitation.
quotes: South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission General Investment Consulting Services RFP
Deadline for Proposal Submission December 1, 2016 – 5:00 p.m. EST
